name: [NEW ISLAND] 💥Super Soldiers
desc:
💥Grapple, Jetpack, and EXPLODE everything in sight!
🏆DESTROY enemy bases, upgrade your gear, and unlock POWERFUL weapons!

💵 Earn cash by killing enemies
⚙️ Earn gear by causing destruction
🏁 Get big rewards for destroying outposts or racing through racetracks

PC CONTROLS:
• GRAPPLE – Q
• SKYDIVE – E

IN-AIR:
• JETPACK – W
• PARACHUTE – SPACE

👍 Like the game for more updates!
🎁 Premium Players receive 15% extra Cash and Gears

❤️ Inspired by Just Cause 3
